turnaround_reason: SRPT was crushed after three patient deaths tied to its gene therapies in 2025 forced an FDA shipment halt and a boxed liver-failure warning on Elevidys, its flagship DMD product. The stock is basing near multi-year lows as the market weighs whether Elevidys revenue can stabilize under the restricted label.
bullish_points: January 2026 EMBARK 3-year data showed durable, statistically significant motor-function benefit vs. matched controls, supporting the drug's efficacy case
Forward P/E ~7.2 with ~$1.97B TTM revenue; still a commercial-stage company, not pre-revenue
July 2025 restructuring cut opex materially, extending cash runway
Basing above the 100d MA (104%); downside may be largely priced after the drawdown from $25 to ~$19
bearish_points: Existential safety/regulatory overhang: gene-therapy deaths and a boxed warning directly threaten the Elevidys revenue trajectory
FDA restricted distribution; revenue visibility is poor and could deteriorate further
Debt/equity ~69.5; balance-sheet flexibility limited if the top line erodes
No insider buying in last 6 months; options open interest is thin
catalyst: Elevidys revenue stabilization and any FDA loosening of distribution restrictions, plus next quarterly print showing whether restructuring is holding the financials together
catalyst_timing: Next quarterly earnings and ongoing FDA label/distribution updates through 2026
suggested_trade: Spot only, small speculative tranche; avoid options (thin OI). Scale in on confirmation the base holds above $17.
key_risk: A fourth adverse safety event or further FDA restriction that collapses Elevidys revenue and the equity thesis outright
would_skip_if: You need clean regulatory visibility; the boxed-warning/death overhang makes this a binary safety bet, not a clean turnaround
